name_zh: 豐臣秀吉：從草莽到天下人的『三段躍升體系』與權勢工程化範式
name_en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi: From Grassroots to Shogun of All Japan — the 'Three-Stage Leap System' and Power Engineering Paradigm
description_zh: 豐臣秀吉（Toyotomi Hideyoshi，1537-1598）是日本戰國時代最具傳奇色彩的統一者，從足輕（步兵）出身的草莽人物，通過對織田信長的忠誠服務和卓越軍事才能崛起為天下人。其核心思維貢獻在於將「三段躍升」工程化為一套可操作的權力獲取與鞏固體系——第一段「身份突破」（從足輕到筆頭家老），第二段「權力重構」（繼承信長遺產並超越之），第三段「制度固化」（太閣檢地、刀狩令、兵農分離）使統一成果得以制度化保存。秀吉的獨特之處在於他深知出身限制了其政權的合法性，因此大量採用「文化收編」策略（茶道、金毘羅信仰、御館之亂的調停者身份）來彌補血統不足。他是Protreptic中模式34（制度化制衡法）在日本戰國政治傳統中的關鍵樣本，也是模式15（框架效應法）在「合法性補償」場景的獨特代表。
description_en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi (1537-1598) was the most legendary unifier in Japan's Sengoku period, rising from ashigaru (foot soldier) origins to become Taiko (Retired Regent) through loyal service to Oda Nobunaga and outstanding military talent. His core thinking contribution lies in engineering a 'Three-Stage Leap' system for power acquisition and consolidation — Stage 1 'Identity Breakthrough' (from foot soldier to chief retainer), Stage 2 'Power Reconstruction' (inheriting and surpassing Nobunaga's legacy), Stage 3 'Institutional Solidification' (Taikou Kenchi land surveys, Sword Hunts,兵農分離) to institutionalize unified achievements. Hideyoshi's uniqueness lies in his awareness that his humble origins limited his regime's legitimacy, thus extensively employing 'cultural co-optation' strategies (tea ceremony, Konpira worship, arbitrator role in Otate Incident) to compensate for bloodline deficiency. He is a key sample of mode 34 (Institutionalized Checks) in Japanese Sengoku political tradition and the unique representative of mode 15 (Framing Effect) in 'legitimacy compensation' scenarios.
reason_zh: 豐臣秀吉填補了Protreptic在「身分跨越型權力建構」領域的日本空白。他是模式15（框架效應法）在「血統不足的文化補償」場景的唯一日本完整樣本，展示了如何通過茶道、御伽眾制度和大坂城文化收編將「草莽出身」轉化為「天下人」的文化合法性；也是模式34（制度化制衡法）在「戰國統一後的制度固化」場景的唯一日本代表。他的三段躍升體系（身份突破→權力重構→制度固化）對現代社會中「非科班出身者的領導力工程化」具有直接啟發價值。
reason_en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi fills Protreptic's Japanese gap in 'cross-class power construction'. He is the only complete Japanese sample of mode 15 (Framing Effect) in 'cultural compensation for bloodline deficiency', demonstrating how tea ceremony, Otogu system and Osaka Castle cultural co-optation convert 'grassroots origins' into 'Taiko' cultural legitimacy; also the sole Japanese representative of mode 34 (Institutionalized Checks) in 'Sengoku post-unification institutional solidification'. His three-stage leap system (identity breakthrough → power reconstruction → institutional solidification) has direct heuristic value for 'non-traditional leadership engineering' in modern society.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式34制度化制衡法）：身份突破與信任累積——從足輕到筆頭家老，通過長篠之戰的功績和對織田信長的絕對忠誠，逐步突破身分壁壘，在15年內從最低階軍卒躍升為五大老之首
第2步（模式15框架效應法）：權力重構與合法性補償——本能寺之變後迅速擊滅明智光秀（山崎之戰），通過「清洲會議」的框架操縱將信長遺產轉化為自己的合法性基礎，以中國大返還越過柴田勝家，最終確立天下人地位
第3步（模式7戰略預判法）：太閣檢地與刀狩令——在全国範圍內實施土地調查（太閣檢地），確立「石高制」經濟基礎；頒布刀狩令解除平民武裝（兵農分離），從根本上消除地方反叛的軍事基礎
第4步（模式31框架效應法）：文化收編與天下人形象——以茶道家身份建立「御伽眾」制度，將文化精英納入權力網絡；通過北野大茶會展示天下無雙的權威；以金毘羅信仰整合地方宗教體系，將文化符號轉化為政治工具
第5步（範式固化）：三段躍升的歷史遺產——將「身份突破→權力重構→制度固化」三環沉澱為可操作的政治工程母板，展示了如何在血統社會中通過戰略行動和文化補償建立跨階層的統治合法性
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 34 Institutionalized Checks): Identity breakthrough and trust accumulation — from ashigaru to chief retainer, through merit at Nagashino Battle and absolute loyalty to Oda Nobunaga, gradually breaking class barriers, rising from lowest soldier to head of Five Elders in 15 years

Step 2 (Mode 15 Framing Effect): Power reconstruction and legitimacy compensation — after Honno-ji Incident, quickly defeating Akechi Mitsuhide (Battles of Yamazaki), manipulating 'Kiyosu Conference' framework to convert Nobunaga's legacy into his own legitimacy base, surpassing Shibata Katsuie through the Chinese Return, ultimately establishing Taiko status

Step 3 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Taikou Kenchi and Sword Hunts — nationwide land surveys establishing 'kokudaka system' economic foundation; Sword Hunt decrees disarming commoners (兵農分離), fundamentally eliminating local rebellion military basis

Step 4 (Mode 31 Framing Effect): Cultural co-optation and Taiko image — establishing 'Otogu' system as tea master, incorporating cultural elites into power network; displaying unparalleled authority through Kitano Grand Tea Gathering; integrating local religious systems through Konpira worship, converting cultural symbols into political tools

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Historical legacy of three-stage leap — condensing 'identity breakthrough → power reconstruction → institutional solidification' into an operable political engineering template, demonstrating how to establish cross-class ruling legitimacy through strategic action and cultural compensation in bloodline society
expected_zh: 掌握豐臣秀吉從足輕到天下人的三段躍升體系及其戰略工程化邏輯
理解太閣檢地、刀狩令、兵農分離三大制度的系統關聯及其對戰國統一後制度固化的貢獻
評估其文化收編策略（茶道、御伽眾）在血統社會中建立合法性的持續價值
expected_en: Master Toyotomi Hideyoshi's three-stage leap system from ashigaru to Taiko and its strategic engineering logic
Understand systemic connections among Taikou Kenchi, Sword Hunts, 兵農分離 three institutions and their contribution to Sengoku post-unification institutional solidification
Evaluate the continuing value of his cultural co-optation strategies (tea ceremony, Otogu) in establishing legitimacy in bloodline society
case_zh: 1537年出生於尾張愛知郡木下家（後改姓羽柴），父親木下彌右衛門為足輕。1553年隨信長上洛，初任靴下（負責鞋履的僕役）。1560年長篠之戰中率先攀爬蔦城梯子建立功績，開始被信長注意。1564年升任筆頭家老（首席重臣），成為織田家五大老的領頭人物。1582年本能寺之變後，山崎之戰中僅用10天從備前趕到大阪擊潰明智光秀（「中國大返還」）。清洲會議上巧妙操縱框架，將信長次子信雄、信孝排除在繼承人之外，擁立信長孫秀太郎（後來的織田秀信），自己獲得越前72萬石。1583年賤岳之戰擊敗柴田勝家，1584年小牧・長久手之戰與德川家康對峙後選擇妥協。1585年任命為太政大臣，同年任關白，成為日本實際統治者。1586年獲賜「豐臣」姓氏並任太閣（前關白）。1588年頒布刀狩令，同年實施太閣檢地確立石高制。1590年小田原征伐消滅北條氏完成統一，1592-1598年兩次侵朝戰爭（文祿・慶長之役）。其最大遺產是通過三段躍升體系確立的戰國統一模式，以及太閣檢地、刀狩令、兵農分離三大制度對日本近世政治經濟結構的深遠影響。
case_en: Born 1537 in Owari Province as Kinoshita Toshiro (later adopted Toyotomi name), father was an ashigaru. 1553 followed Nobunaga to Kyoto, initially serving as kushige (footwear attendant). 1560 Nagashino Battle, first to climb the Tsuta castle wall earning recognition. 1564 promoted to head retainer among Oda's Five Elders. 1582 Honno-ji Incident, Yamazaki Battle in just 10 days from Bitchu to Osaka defeating Akechi Mitsuhide (the 'Chinese Return'). Kiyosu Conference skillfully manipulated framework, excluding Nobunaga's second sons Hidetaka and Nobukatsu, supporting Nobunaga's grandson Hideuteru (later Oda Hidenobu), receiving Echizen 720,000 koku. 1583 Shizugatake Battle defeating Shibata Katsuie, 1584 Komaki-Nagasakate对峙 with Tokugawa Ieyasu then choosing compromise. 1585 appointed Daijo-daijin, same year Kampaku (Regent), became de facto ruler. 1586 granted Toyotomi surname and appointed Taiko (Retired Regent). 1588 Sword Hunt decree, same year Taikou Kenchi land surveys establishing kokudaka system. 1590 Odawara campaign eliminating Hojo clan completing unification, 1592-1598 two invasions of Korea (Bunroku-Keicho campaigns). His greatest legacy is the Three-Stage Leap system establishing Sengoku unification model, plus Taikou Kenchi, Sword Hunts, and 兵農分離 three institutions' profound impact on early modern Japanese political-economic structure.
